name: Tau hu nong
summary: Tàu hũ nóng is hot soft tofu with sweet-sour fish sauce or soy sauce. Vietnam Airlines calls it mildly fatty and lightly aromatic, and prints 15,000–30,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines names Thùy Vân and Hoàng Hoa Thám.
howToEat: Eat it hot, with one of the two sauces.
Vietnam Airlines calls it a snack or a first plate. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Thùy Vân and Hoàng Hoa Thám. A shop name is not published here. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Tau hu nong — hot tofu in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Hot tofu on Thùy Vân and Hoàng Hoa Thám, with fish sauce or soy sauce. Vietnam Airlines prints 15,000–30,000 VND.
